# Loading Packages
```{r}
rm(list = ls())

suppressMessages(library("ggplot2"))
suppressMessages(library("patchwork"))
suppressMessages(library("ggpubr"))
suppressMessages(library("maftools"))
suppressMessages(library("tidyr"))
suppressMessages(library("broom"))
suppressMessages(library("data.table"))
suppressMessages(library("dplyr"))
suppressMessages(library("forcats"))
suppressMessages(library("textshape"))
suppressMessages(library("ggrepel"))
suppressMessages(library("tibble"))
suppressMessages(library("readr"))
suppressMessages(library("ggradar"))
suppressMessages(library("ggsci"))
suppressMessages(library("cowplot"))
suppressMessages(library("ggdist"))

PCAWG_path <- ".../Project/"
source(paste0(PCAWG_path, "/code/source/basic.R"))
source(paste0(PCAWG_path, "/code/source/oncoplot2.R"))

LOH_MSI = LOH_mut <- fread(paste0(PCAWG_path, "/donors_and_biospecimens/LOH_MSI_final.csv"))
LOH_type <- LOH_MSI %>% mutate(sample_id = aliquot_id) %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, histology_abbreviation)
LOH_aliquot <- LOH_MSI %>% mutate(sample_id = aliquot_id) %>% dplyr::select(sample_id, icgc_sample_id, MSI_mut)
LOH_MSS <- LOH_MSI %>% filter(MSI_mut == "MSS")
sample_MSS <- LOH_MSS  %>% pull(aliquot_id)

color_event <- c("Mut" = "#E64B35FF", "WT" = "#4DBBD5FF")
color_APM_envet <- c("APM-Mutant" = "#E64B35FF", "APM-WT" = "#4DBBD5FF")
figure_path <- ".../Project/Figures/20250813/"
```

# Combine HLA mutations and LOHHLA results
```{r}
path_maf <- ".../Project/consensus_snv_indel/maf/maf_from_vcf/"

onco_APM_update <- fread(paste0(path_maf, "onco_APM_update.txt"))

## With homo deletion
onco_hlaloh <- fread(".../Project/consensus_snv_indel/maf/onco_hlaloh.txt")

## Without
#onco_hlaloh <- fread(".../Project/consensus_snv_indel/maf/onco_hlaloh_nohomo.txt")

mat1 <- rbind(onco_APM_update, onco_hlaloh, fill = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%    
  column_to_rownames("V1") %>% dplyr::select(any_of(sample_MSS))

missing_cols <- setdiff(sample_MSS, colnames(mat1))
mat1[missing_cols] <- NA_character_
mat1 <- mat1[, sample_MSS]

mat1 <- as.matrix(mat1) 
mat1[is.na(mat1)] <- "" 
mat1[mat1 == "0"] <- "" 
dim(mat1)

write.table(mat1, paste0(path_maf, "onco_APM_hlaloh.txt"), sep = "\t", quote = FALSE)

title = "Antigen Presentation Machinery"
filename = paste0(figure_path, "/Figure1a.pdf")
pdf(paste0(filename), width = 6.5, height = 2.5)
      ht1 <-  oncoPrint(mat1,
                        alter_fun = alter_fun,
                        alter_fun_is_vectorized = T,
                        pct_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), 
                        col = col,
                        show_pct = T,
                        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7), 
                        column_title = title,
                        top_annotation = NULL,
                        remove_empty_columns = TRUE,
                        heatmap_legend_param = heatmap_legend_param,
                        pct_side = "right", 
                        row_names_side = "left")
draw(ht1, heatmap_legend_side = "bottom")
dev.off()
```

# Calculate the frequencies
```{r}
mat1 <- fread(paste0(path_maf, "onco_APM_hlaloh.txt")) %>% 
  column_to_rownames("V1") %>% 
  as.matrix()

# Check
APM_mut <- as.data.frame(mat1) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "aliquot_id", values_to = "Status") %>%
  filter(Status != "")  %>% filter(Status != "HLALOH", aliquot_id %in% sample_MSS)
length(unique(APM_mut$aliquot_id))
table(APM_mut$Gene)
## 188 + APM mutations in 154 patients (Some samples were marked as multi-hit)
154/2625

APM_HLALOH <- as.data.frame(mat1) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "aliquot_id", values_to = "Status") %>%
  filter(Status != "") %>% filter(Status == "HLALOH", aliquot_id %in% sample_MSS)
length(unique(APM_HLALOH$aliquot_id))
## 438 patients with HLA LOH
438/2625

APM_HLAmut <- as.data.frame(mat1) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "aliquot_id", values_to = "Status") %>%
  filter(Status != "") %>% filter(Gene %in% c("HLA-A", "HLA-B", "HLA-C"), aliquot_id %in% sample_MSS)
length(unique(APM_HLAmut$aliquot_id))
## 57 HLA mutations in 52 patients

APM_nonHLAmut <- as.data.frame(mat1) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(-Gene, names_to = "aliquot_id", values_to = "Status") %>%
  filter(Status != "") %>% filter(!Gene %in% c("HLA-A", "HLA-B", "HLA-C", "HLALOH"), aliquot_id %in% sample_MSS)
length(unique(APM_nonHLAmut$aliquot_id))
## 131 non-HLA mutations in 110 samples
```
